description:
## Files
- src/vug/manifest_extractor.cr
- src/vug/favicon_resolver.cr

### ManifestExtractor
| Current (4+ words) | Proposed |
|---|---|
| `extract_favicons_from_manifest` | `extract_manifest_favicons` |

This is a public method on ManifestExtractor. Check if it's used externally — if so, add an alias and deprecate the old name. If internal only, just rename.

### FaviconResolver
| Current (4+ words) | Proposed |
|---|---|
| `extract_favicons_from_site` | `extract_site_favicons` |
| `try_extracted_favicon` (3 words, fine) | keep |

### Also in FaviconResolver, check 3-word methods that could be clearer:
| `try_standard_paths` | keep |
| `try_fallback_chain` | keep |
| `generate_placeholder_fallback` | `placeholder_fallback` |

Run `crystal spec` to verify.
title: Shorten private methods in ManifestExtractor and FaviconResolver
